screening_answers.question: How many years of full-stack experience do you have?
screening_answers.answer: 3 years as a Full Stack Developer at a US-based medical-device company (Mar 2023 - Sep 2026), building web applications, internal AI agents and a CRM. I have also shipped 30+ projects, including full-stack products with Postgres, Stripe and auth.

screening_answers.question: Which AI agent frameworks have you used?
screening_answers.answer: I built multi-agent-research-crew on a custom DAG orchestrator in Python asyncio with Claude, with retries, timeouts, token budgets and claim-level citation checking. I also built site-to-agent and ai-lead-receptionist. I have not used LangChain or LangGraph in production, but the concepts transfer and I can pick them up quickly.

screening_answers.question: How do you use AI coding assistants in your workflow?
screening_answers.answer: I use Claude Code every day to plan, build and test features. I hold the Claude Code in Action and Claude Code 101 certifications from Anthropic. I review the output, keep tests such as the 10 end-to-end API tests on my portfolio backend, and use evals to check the AI features I build.

screening_answers.question: Do you have experience mentoring junior engineers?
screening_answers.answer: I have no formal mentoring role on my CV. I lead technology and architect the curriculum at NeuroNetworks AI Ed, which involves explaining engineering concepts to learners. I am ready to take on mentorship and to work closely with senior engineers to grow into it.

screening_answers.question: What is your notice period and salary expectation?
screening_answers.answer: Notice period: immediate. I am based in Pune (IST, UTC+05:30) and can overlap with US mornings if needed. I am targeting INR 30,000 per month or more, and I am flexible on structure; the work and the team matter most.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Full Stack+AI Engineer role. I have 3 years of full-stack experience at a US-based medical-device company, where I built web applications, internal AI agents and a CRM. My daily stack is TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL, which matches your required skills.

On the AI side, I built multi-agent-research-crew, with planner, researcher, writer and verifier agents on a custom orchestrator with retries, token budgets and citation checks. I also built site-to-agent, a grounded RAG chat agent with an eval harness, and PageForge, a Next.js product where AI drafts only from approved facts and a validator checks the numbers. I use Claude Code every day and hold the Claude Code in Action and Claude Code 101 certifications.

I have not yet built voice agents or used LangChain or LangGraph professionally, but I ship quickly and learn new stacks fast. I am based in Pune, available immediately, and ready to grow into mentoring. My portfolio is at hussain-singapuri.vercel.app.
